ECO GOODIES BAG – F | Eco-Friendly Gift Set | J485

The ECO GOODIES BAG – F is a thoughtfully curated eco-friendly gift set designed for sustainable corporate gifting, employee welcome kits, event giveaways, and environmentally responsible celebrations. Created with high-quality eco-materials and plantable stationery, this green gift hamper promotes sustainability while offering a premium unboxing experience. With eco-conscious gifting at a rising trend, this product is the perfect blend of usability, style, and environmental responsibility.

This ECO GOODIES BAG – F eco-friendly gift set includes innovative plantable stationery items such as the Plantable Calendar (Wood), Plantable Pen Pencil (2+2), Mini Grow GIY Kit, and Plantable Notepad B6 (Pin). Each item is crafted to reduce waste and encourage eco-awareness, making it a fantastic choice for companies looking to align their gifting strategy with sustainability goals.

Packed in a premium jute mesh pouch with cotton net and zip (10″x10″x2″), this eco goodies bag adds a natural, rustic charm to your corporate gifting. The bag itself is reusable, durable, and adds to the sustainable value of the hamper. Whether you’re planning a corporate event, festive gifting, seminar giveaway, or employee onboarding kit, this environmentally friendly gift pack is an excellent eco-conscious choice.

What Makes ECO GOODIES BAG – F Special?

This gift set is intentionally designed to reduce carbon footprint and promote environmental wellbeing. Each item in this eco-friendly gift set is either plantable, biodegradable, or reusable—making it an exceptional alternative to traditional corporate gifts. This makes the ECO GOODIES BAG – F one of the most preferred sustainable corporate gift options for brands aiming to support green initiatives and environmentally conscious practices.

Key Features of ECO GOODIES BAG – F

  • Eco-Friendly Gift Set (J485) designed for green corporate gifting and eco events.
  • Plantable Calendar (Wood) — a natural wooden stand with seed paper calendar sheets.
  • Plantable Pen Pencil Set (2+2) — biodegradable pens and pencils with seed capsules that grow into plants.
  • Mini Grow Kit (GIY) — Grow-It-Yourself kit enabling users to plant herbs or flowers at home or office.
  • Plantable Notepad B6 (Pin) — eco notepad made with seed paper for sustainable writing.
  • Premium Jute Mesh Pouch with Cotton Net and Zip (10″x10″x2″) — reusable, durable, and eco-friendly packaging.
  • Perfect for corporate events, festive gifts, eco campaigns, employee joining kits, and brand promotions.
  • Supports CSR initiatives and green gifting trends.

Why Choose This Eco-Friendly Gift Set?

The ECO GOODIES BAG – F | Eco-Friendly Gift Set is purposefully developed for businesses that value sustainability and want to inspire eco-friendly habits among employees and clients. With plantable stationery that encourages growth and greener living, this set brings long-term value beyond traditional accessories. Its natural and elegant packaging further enhances its appeal as a premium corporate gifting solution.

Whether you’re looking to impress clients, welcome new team members, or host an eco-conscious event, this eco-friendly gift set delivers an impactful message—one of responsibility, sustainability, and positive environmental action.
